name: coding-tech-ai-digest
description: Developer intelligence: new frameworks, AI models releases, programming language updates, dev tools, infrastructure news for software engineers

steps.name: fetch-framework-releases
steps.prompt:
Check for new framework and library releases in the last week:

PRIMARY SOURCES:
1. Check official release pages/changelogs:
   - React: https://github.com/facebook/react/releases.atom or RSS
   - Vue.js: https://github.com/vuejs/core/releases
   - Angular: https://github.com/angular/angular/releases
   - Next.js: https://github.com/vercel/next.js/releases
   - Svelte: https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/releases
   - Remix: https://github.com/remix-run/remix/releases

2. RSS feeds:
   - Hacker News (for Show HN releases): https://news.ycombinator.com/rss
   - Dev.to releases: https://dev.to/feed/tag/releases
   - Echo JS: http://www.echojs.com/rss

WHAT TO LOOK FOR:
- Major version releases (React 19, Vue 4, Next.js 15, etc.)
- Breaking changes announcements
- New features (React Server Components, Vue Vapor mode, etc.)
- Deprecation notices
- Performance improvements
- Security patches

Extract for each release:
- Framework name and version
- Release date
- Key new features (1-2 bullet points)
- Breaking changes (if any)
- Migration guide availability
- Community reaction/votes if from HN

Focus on major releases from last 7 days. Return structured list.

steps.name: fetch-ai-model-releases
steps.prompt:
Check for new AI/ML model releases and updates:

SOURCES:
1. HuggingFace: https://huggingface.co/blog/feed.xml
2. OpenAI Blog: https://openai.com/blog/rss.xml (if available)
3. Anthropic: https://www.anthropic.com/rss.xml (if available)
4. Google AI Blog: https://ai.googleblog.com/feeds/posts/default
5. Stability AI: https://stability.ai/news (check RSS)
6. Midjourney: https://docs.midjourney.com/changelog (web scrape if needed)

7. Check Hacker News for:
   - "new model" releases
   - "LLM" announcements
   - "GPT-4", "Claude", "Llama", "Gemini" news

8. Check AI research:
   - Papers with Code: https://paperswithcode.com/rss
   - arXiv AI: https://export.arxiv.org/rss/cs.AI

WHAT TO LOOK FOR:
- New LLM releases (GPT updates, Claude versions, open source models)
- Image generation models (Stable Diffusion updates, Midjourney versions)
- Code models (GitHub Copilot updates, CodeLlama, etc.)
- Multimodal models (vision + text)
- API pricing changes
- Performance benchmarks (better than GPT-4? OpenAI vs Anthropic competition)
- Open source releases (Llama 3, Mistral updates, etc.)

Extract for each:
- Model name and version/variant
- Company/research group
- Key capabilities/improvements
- Benchmark results (if available)
- API/availability status
- Open source or proprietary

Return 5-8 most significant AI releases from last week.

steps.name: fetch-language-updates
steps.prompt:
Check for programming language releases and updates:

SOURCES:
1. Language release pages:
   - Python: https://www.python.org/downloads/ or https://blog.python.org/
   - TypeScript: https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/releases
   - Rust: https://blog.rust-lang.org/ (check for new version announcements)
   - Go: https://go.dev/blog/
   - Java: https://openjdk.org/jeps/
   - C# / .NET: https://devblogs.microsoft.com/dotnet/
   - Swift: https://swift.org/blog/
   - Kotlin: https://blog.jetbrains.com/kotlin/
   - Ruby: https://www.ruby-lang.org/en/news/
   - PHP: https://www.php.net/releases/

2. Developer news:
   - InfoQ: https://www.infoq.com/feed/
   - The New Stack: https://thenewstack.io/feed/
   - DZone: https://feeds.dzone.com/home

WHAT TO LOOK FOR:
- New language versions (Python 3.13, Go 1.23, Rust 1.80, etc.)
- Major features added (Python performance improvements, Rust features, etc.)
- Deprecation notices and breaking changes
- LTS (Long Term Support) announcements
- Security patches
- Toolchain updates (cargo, npm, pip, etc.)

Extract for each:
- Language and version
- Release date
- Key features/improvements (1-2 bullets)
- Breaking changes if any
- Performance improvements (benchmarks if mentioned)
- Community significance

Return 4-6 notable language updates from last week.

steps.name: fetch-dev-tools-infrastructure
steps.prompt:
Check for developer tools, infrastructure, and platform updates:

TOOLS TO TRACK:

CI/CD & DevOps:
- GitHub Actions updates: https://github.blog/changelog/label/actions/feed/ (check if RSS)
- GitLab releases: https://about.gitlab.com/releases/categories/releases/
- Jenkins updates
- CircleCI, Travis, etc. updates

Cloud & Infrastructure:
- AWS updates: https://aws.amazon.com/new/feed/ (if available)
- Vercel: https://vercel.com/changelog (scrape or RSS)
- Netlify: https://www.netlify.com/blog/rss.xml
- Cloudflare: https://blog.cloudflare.com/rss
- Docker: https://www.docker.com/blog/feed/
- Kubernetes: https://kubernetes.io/feed.xml

Databases:
- PostgreSQL: https://www.postgresql.org/about/news/
- MongoDB blog/changelog
- Redis updates
- Supabase: https://supabase.com/changelog (check for RSS)
- Prisma ORM updates

Developer Tools:
- VS Code: https://code.visualstudio.com/updates (check RSS)
- JetBrains: https://blog.jetbrains.com/feed/
- Cursor, Windsurf (AI editors)
- Git updates
- Homebrew updates (shows ecosystem trends)

Check these sources:
- Hacker News (for Show HN tool releases)
- Product Hunt (top dev tools)
- Dev.to tools tag

WHAT TO LOOK FOR:
- New product launches
- Major version updates
- AI-powered features added to existing tools
- Performance improvements
- New integrations
- Pricing changes (free tier updates, etc.)
- Open source releases of previously proprietary tools

Extract 6-8 significant tool/infrastructure updates.

steps.name: fetch-trending-repos
steps.prompt:
Get trending GitHub repositories by category:

Use GitHub Search API or trending page (scrape if needed):

URL pattern for API:
https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=created:>{DATE_7_DAYS_AGO}&sort=stars&order=desc&per_page=10

WHERE:
- Total stars > 100 (filter out too new/empty)
- Created in last 7 days OR
- Recently trending (check https://github.com/trending)

CATEGORIES TO CHECK (separate searches):
- JavaScript/TypeScript: language:javascript or language:typescript
- Python: language:python
- Rust: language:rust
- Go: language:go
- AI/ML repos (topic:machine-learning, topic:llm, topic:ai)
- Developer tools (topic:developer-tools, topic:cli)

Extract for each trending repo:
- Name and link
- Language
- Star count (and daily gain if available)
- Description
- Why it's trending (AI tool? New framework? Cool utility?)

Focus on repos gaining traction this week. Return 6-8 most interesting repos across categories.

steps.name: fetch-tech-news-developer
steps.prompt:
Fetch developer-focused tech news from industry sources:

SOURCES:
- TechCrunch Developer: https://techcrunch.com/category/developer/feed/
- The Verge Tech: https://www.theverge.com/tech/rss/index.xml
- Ars Technica: http://feeds.arstechnica.com/arstechnica/index
- Wired Software: https://www.wired.com/category/business/software/feed/
- ZDNet Developer: https://www.zdnet.com/news/rss.xml
- InfoQ: https://www.infoq.com/feed/
- The New Stack: https://thenewstack.io/feed/
- Dev.to top: https://dev.to/feed
- CSS-Tricks: https://css-tricks.com/feed/
- Smashing Magazine: https://www.smashingmagazine.com/feed/

FOCUS ON STORIES ABOUT:
- Big Tech developer announcements (Google I/O, Apple WWDC, Microsoft Build news)
- API changes and deprecations (Twitter/X API, Reddit API, etc.)
- Developer platform changes (GitHub features, GitLab updates)
- Open source governance issues
- Security vulnerabilities (CVEs affecting developers)
- Tech layoffs affecting engineering teams
- Remote work trends for developers
- AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, etc.) updates
- Salary/compensation trends

Extract 6-8 most relevant developer news stories with:
- Headline
- Source
- 1-2 sentence summary
- Why it matters to developers

Return as news list.

steps.name: format-coding-digest
steps.prompt:
Create a comprehensive Coding, Tech & AI Digest for Discord developers.

**FRAMEWORK RELEASES:**
{{framework_releases}}

**AI/ML RELEASES:**
{{ai_releases}}

**LANGUAGE UPDATES:**
{{language_updates}}

**DEV TOOLS & INFRASTRUCTURE:**
{{dev_tools}}

**TRENDING REPOSITORIES:**
{{trending_repos}}

**TECH NEWS:**
{{tech_news}}

FORMAT:
```
💻 **Coding, Tech & AI Digest — {date}**

**🎨 Frontend Frameworks**
• Framework vX.X — [Key feature] — [Breaking changes?] — [Link]
• Framework vX.X — [What's new]
• Notable: [mention if major release or skip section]

**🤖 AI Models & Tools**
• Model Name vX — [Capability improvement] — [Open/Closed source] — Benchmarks: [XX% on Y]
• GitHub Copilot/Cursor update — [New feature]
• [Open source release] — [Significance]
• 🆕 [Model comparison] — [How it ranks vs GPT-4/Claude/etc]

**⚙️ Programming Languages**
• Language vX.X — [Key improvements] — [Performance boost?]
• Language vX.X — [Notable features]

**🛠️ Dev Tools & Infrastructure**
• Tool Name — [What's new] — [AI features?] — [Pricing change?]
• Cloud Provider — [New service/feature]
• Database/Platform — [Update]

**⭐ Trending This Week**
• user/repo (Language) — Description — ⭐ XXX stars
• user/repo (Language) — Description — ⭐ XXX stars
• user/repo (Language) — Description — ⭐ XXX stars

**📰 Developer News**
• [Headline] — [1-line summary] — Why it matters: [reason]
• [Headline] — [Summary] — Impact: [developer relevance]
• [Security/Layoff/API change news if significant]

**🎯 This Week For Developers**
1. [Biggest framework change and what to do about it]
2. [Most exciting AI tool to try]
3. [Language update worth upgrading for]

```

Tone: Developer-to-developer. Include practical implications ("should you upgrade?", "breaking changes to watch for", "cool thing to try").

Keep under 2000 characters. Use technical but accessible language. Include GitHub links where relevant.
